resources.string: Skips the full-screen ad shown when the app starts or returns.
Stops ads on Home, Search, Library, and playlists from loading.
Plays the next track without the voice or network ad between tracks.
Hides automatic Premium sheets and the pop-ups shown for Premium-only features. Premium registration stays available in Settings.
Shows the English or romanized title VocaDB lists for the exact Niconico video, in the player. The video id of each track in the player is sent to vocadb.net; results are cached on the device.

When you share a work, uses the YouTube original that VocaDB lists for the exact Niconico video instead of the Niconico link. A video VocaDB hasn\'t been asked about yet is looked up, and keeps the Niconico link until the next share.

Translates Japanese song titles across the app: Home, search, rankings, playlists, and the player. Titles are sent to the translation service below, many at a time; translations are cached on the device, and titles VocaDB already provides are not sent.
Adds a Translate button under a work\'s description, which shows its translation in place of the original. The description is sent to the translation service below only when you tap it.
Shows work tags on the detail screen and popular tags in Search translated, with the service below, which receives them. Tapping a tag still searches the original Japanese tag.
Adds the romanized reading under each Japanese lyric line, from Google Translate, which receives the lines. Works for VocaColle\'s lyrics and other sources\' alike.
Adds a translation under each Japanese lyric line, with the service below, which receives the lines. The lyrics themselves stay as they are.
Translates notice titles in Settings with the service below, and opens notice articles through Google Translate\'s page translation, which receives the article\'s address.
For the OpenAI-compatible service: the endpoint before /chat/completions, over HTTPS.
For the OpenAI-compatible service: the model name your provider expects.
For the OpenAI-compatible service. Stored encrypted on this device, and left out of settings exports.

When VocaColle has no lyrics for a song, or can\'t show them, shows lyrics from the sources below for the exact Niconico video, found through VocaDB. The video id goes to vocadb.net, and the song\'s name and producer to the sources.
Same as the app (Korean or English)
Couldn\'t translate the description. Check the connection and the translation service, then try again.
Set up the translation service in the Reseam patches screen first.
Comma-separated, tried in order: lrclib (LRCLIB), netease (NetEase Cloud Music), kugou (KuGou), vocadb (VocaDB, untimed).
Shows every page of a ranking (up to 300 songs) instead of only the top 100. The extra pages come from VocaColle\'s own ranking service, two more requests when a ranking opens.
Shows ☆ Favorite and + Playlist buttons on a work\'s detail screen, for the favorites and playlists on this device.
Favorites and playlists on this device

Favorites and any number of playlists, saved on this device only, with no limit: nothing is sent, and your likes and mylists don\'t change. Play them in VocaColle\'s player, and export or import them as text.
Added to the favorites on this device
No favorites yet. Add songs with the ☆ Favorite button on a work\'s detail screen.
Export copies the favorites and every playlist as text and opens the share sheet. Import adds the songs and playlists of an exported text that aren\'t here yet.
Couldn\'t open the playlist in VocaColle.
That isn\'t an exported favorites list.
This playlist is empty. Add songs with the + Playlist button on a work\'s detail screen.
Delete this playlist and its song list? Songs stay in your other lists.
A playlist with that name already exists.
VocaDB answers, translations, and lyrics are kept so they aren\'t asked for again. Clearing one makes the next look-up ask again. Favorites and playlists aren\'t a cache and stay.
How the lyrics reading is written: in Latin letters (romaji), or in Hangul as Koreans read Japanese. Auto uses Hangul when translating into Korean.
